name: Gekka no Chigiri
source:
Kaguya Hime, who was confined at the palace by the emperor, was unable to return to the moon and lost her life in a mysterious fire. "My kind beloved. After 1200 years, let us meet again under the moonlight" were her last words before she died. 

1200 years have passed. A priest, who is a direct descendant of the emperor, discovers a mirage-like beautiful boy in the bamboo forest on his property. Other than his name being Saku, he doesn't remember anything else. Later, it is discovered that he is the reincarnation of Kaguya Hime. At the same time, some men appear at the priest's mansion to take away Saku. They are descendants of the nobles from Kaguya's time, who came with marriage proposals to her. History repeats and once again, they became enchanted with the beautiful Saku...

Who was Kaguya Hime's true love? What was the truth behind her death? And what kind of fate awaits Saku?

[From Aarinfantasy Forums]
translation:
辉夜姬被天皇囚禁在宫中，无法返回月亮，最终在一场神秘火灾中丧生。“我亲爱的爱人，一千二百年后，让我们再次于月光下相会。”这是她临终前留下的话。

一千二百年过去了。一名天皇直系后裔的僧侣，在自家竹林中发现了一个如幻影般美丽的少年。除了知道自己名叫朔外，少年不记得任何事。后来，人们发现他竟是辉夜姬的转世。与此同时，几名男子来到僧侣宅邸，企图带走朔。他们都是辉夜姬所处时代那些曾向她求婚的贵族后裔。历史重演，他们再次为美丽的朔倾倒…

辉夜姬真正爱的人是谁？她死亡的真相究竟如何？等待朔的又会是怎样的命运？
